spec_match.rationale: Explores the exact two-stage negotiation between CSS Images Module Level 3 (object-fit / object-position on <object> and <embed>) and the inner SVG root's viewBox / preserveAspectRatio and intrinsic dimensions.

interactive.rationale: Interactive selectors for preserveAspectRatio, fixed vs viewBox-only SVG dimensions, CSS object-fit, and CSS object-position dynamically rebuild the embedded SVG data URI and inspect getScreenCTM().

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index blurb promising a two-stage negotiation matrix between CSS object-fit/object-position and SVG preserveAspectRatio.

edge_cases.rationale: Highlights the non-obvious interaction where object-fit: fill stretches the outer concrete object rectangle while preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' still letterboxes inside that rectangle unless preserveAspectRatio='none', plus viewBox-only SVGs without fixed pixel width/height.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified matrix selector combinations, Stage 1 / Stage 2 table readouts, and responsive rendering on 360px mobile and 1280px desktop viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('preserveaspectratio-matrix-updated') on every matrix change with zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Uses CSS variables from /public/styles.css and named SVG colors (teal, gold, ivory, black) with zero raw hex/rgba/hsla values.

accessibility.rationale: All 4 select controls have explicit <label> associations and >=44px tap height, <object> and <embed> have title and aria-label, and <output> uses aria-live='polite'.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Wraps the stage breakdown table in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto } and constrains .host-el to max-width: 100% so 360px mobile viewports have zero horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer rendering heavy content below the fold
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size on off-screen code and reference sections.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .deferred-section to the code path and see-also sections.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible select inputs and 44px minimum touch height
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every <select> with an explicit <label> and ensure 44px minimum height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Paired #par-select, #intrinsic-select, #css-fit-select, and #css-pos-select with explicit <label> tags and min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible embedded SVG containers and live regions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide title and aria-label on <object> and <embed> elements and announce dynamic CTM updates in an aria-live='polite' region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added title and aria-label to #matrix-object and #matrix-embed and aria-live='polite' to #matrix-output.

guidanceConsulted.query: prevent table and replaced element overflow on 360px mobile viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use overflow-x: auto table containers and max-width: 100% on replaced elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped the two-stage breakdown table in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto } and set max-width: 100% on .host-el.

summary: Interactive two-stage negotiation matrix testing how CSS object-fit/object-position on <object>/<embed> compose with root SVG preserveAspectRatio.
